title: Nourishing Slovakian Date Paella
description: A charred, dense, comforting Slovakian dish featuring Medjool dates, made egg‑free in a paella pan.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a paella pan over medium heat until shimmering.
Add diced onion and minced garlic; sauté until onions are translucent.
Stir in sliced red bell pepper and cook for 2 minutes until slightly softened.
Sprinkle 200g short‑grain rice and 50g barley into the pan, tossing to coat with oil and vegetables.
Mix in 2 tbsp tomato paste and 1 tsp smoked paprika, cooking for 1 minute to release flavors.
Pour 500ml vegetable broth into the pan, stirring to combine, then bring the mixture to a gentle boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover partially, and simmer for 15 minutes, allowing the grains to absorb liquid.
Add 150g chopped Medjool dates, stir gently, and continue cooking for another 10 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Remove the pan from heat, fluff the paella with a fork, and let it stand for 5 minutes.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.
